## Closure verification — landed on main

Problem: the claim-gate freshness re-check failed open when an ATTESTED gate ref/snapshot was unobtainable, because the substituted working-tree basis was not visible to the consumer.

Proven root cause: `gate_ref_hash_basis`/`_hash_basis` had a documented `.degraded` contract, but the claim-gate scoped drift verifier had not consumed that signal; the verifier could certify stale scoped hashes against a substituted working tree instead of failing closed. Authority: `manifest.py`/`attest.py` docstrings, `docs/plan-review-gate.md` fail-closed claim-gate contract, ADR 0002.

Proof: runtime scenario toggling only gate-ref resolvability reproduced the former fail-open (`certified`) vs resolvable-ref `stale-code`; current main now returns `stale-code` for the attested-degraded case, while `source=local` and pre-S4b legacy attestations remain certified where intended.

Defect origin: recorded as caused by `72d9-8fbd-3a9e-48a6` (`athletic-esthetical-polecat`) by scope-of-work/plan-defect: that story introduced scoped attested drift detection and should have wired the degraded-basis consumer.

Test: `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_ref_coherence.py` contains the RED→GREEN attested-degraded regression test plus source=local/legacy guards. Mutation checks were run under macOS `sandbox-exec`: removing the fail-closed guard returned the positive test to RED; dropping the legacy-tolerance conjunct returned the negative test to RED.

Fix: merged Gerrit change 2357, commit `1c0a202b6d28deb225fd08b7eaa990dd3507fa2d` on `origin/main`, with `rebar-ticket: 505d-b2c5-734f-47d9`. It preserves signing-time hashing and `_hash_basis`'s lenient path-returning contract, and only makes the claim-gate verifier refuse a degraded attested basis with `stale-code`.

Scope & safety: caller sweep shows the only production freshness consumer is the plan-review claim-gate path; review-bot care point verified safe because its bugfix-size gate buckets `certified`, `stale-code`, and `stale-head` as accepted. No new dependency and no test weakening.

Siblings: no additional construct siblings found beyond this single consumer; parity surfaces share the same core verifier.

Residual risk & prevention: none observed beyond the now-covered legacy-tolerance edge.

Replication / validation: commit is merged with Gerrit `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`; local final gates passed on current `origin/main`: targeted attestation/ref-coherence/review-bot tests (118 passed), `make lint`, and `make typecheck`.
